channel.title: Global Women
channel.desc: The animated film KPop Demon Hunters became an instant global hit when it was released in June, and it brought Korean-American star Arden Cho a new generation of fans. Cho tells BBC Global Women about her childhood in Texas, and her struggles with her identity and the way she looked. But now, with the international rise in popularity of Korean culture and entertainment and the success of this film, she says she feels proud of her heritage.
